evidence.title: Devin Desktop
evidence.finding: Explicitly names Windsurf rename with plans/settings carried over; advertises Spaces and Kanban.

evidence.title: Introducing Devin
evidence.finding: Cloud web IDE/browser/shell and CLI-to-cloud handoff; external ticket/chat intake.

evidence.title: Introducing Devin
evidence.finding: Devin cloud provides shell, IDE and interactive browser tools; local CLI can hand work to cloud.

evidence.title: Devin pricing
evidence.finding: Free desktop access differs from Pro cloud access; Teams has a base fee plus full developer seats, while quota amounts are not fixed in the FAQ.

evidence.title: Devin API overview
evidence.finding: The v3 organization and enterprise APIs manage sessions and context resources with service users or personal tokens; attribution requires defined permissions.

evidence.title: Security profiles
evidence.finding: Security profiles separately restrict network, external MCP, Devin-management tools and Git writes; child sessions inherit the profile chain.

evidence.title: Welcome to Devin Desktop
evidence.finding: Devin Desktop installs on macOS, Windows and Linux; its primary local harness is Devin Local, shared with Devin CLI. A Devin account is required; cloud and local workflows remain distinct.

evidence.title: Devin CLI Quickstart
evidence.finding: Devin CLI runs locally on macOS, Linux and Windows. Cloud Devin runs in a VM. CLI currently does not support account Knowledge, Playbooks or Secrets; these are planned, not shipped.

evidence.title: Devin Cloud in the Devin CLI
evidence.locator: Start; Resume; Continue locally; Local Hands
evidence.finding: Cloud sessions run on their own VM and continue when the terminal closes. Resume accepts a session URL/ID. Pickup checks out the PR branch locally; Local Hands requires per-call approval.

evidence.title: Devin CLI Subagents
evidence.locator: How Subagents Work; Cost; Model profiles
evidence.finding: Foreground children wait with interactive approvals; background children run concurrently and deny unapproved tools. The parent receives completion and summarizes results. Each child has independent inference costs and profile-selected model.

evidence.title: Devin Knowledge
evidence.finding: Knowledge stores shared instructions, supports trigger retrieval and repo/organization/enterprise scope, user toggles and corrections. It is deprecated and gradually migrating to Skills in Plugins; future removal has no stated date.

evidence.title: Session Insights
evidence.finding: Completed sessions have free Insights with usage, message count, size classification, issue timeline and knowledge analysis. Full large-session analysis is automatic; smaller sessions can request analysis through UI or API.

evidence.title: Devin Review
evidence.locator: Features; Reading a Review; PR Workflow Actions; Permissions
evidence.finding: Devin Review displays grouped diffs, supports comments and request changes, retains analyses and CI status, and offers provider-dependent PR workflow actions. Write actions require appropriate connected identities and permissions.

evidence.title: Security at Cognition
evidence.locator: Privacy and IP; Retention; Third-party audits
evidence.finding: Cognition states SOC 2 Type II since September 2024. Training is on by default except Enterprise without written consent; paid users can opt out. Customer data is retained during the relationship, while interaction/feedback retention is separately determined.

evidence.title: Devin Plans and Pricing
evidence.finding: Free desktop access has a light agent quota. Pro costs $20/month, Max $200. Teams charge $80/month plus $40/full-development seat. Paid usage allowances refresh daily and weekly; extra usage is at API pricing.

evidence.title: Welcome to Devin Desktop
evidence.locator: Set Up > Linux deb/rpm repository notes; Uninstall > Windows pre-rename folder note
evidence.finding: Vendor explicitly calls windsurf repository names pre-rebrand, names devin-desktop as the new package, and retains a transitional windsurf package for existing installs. Windows installations from before the rename may retain a Windsurf folder. This establishes the editor lineage, not a former name for Devin cloud.

vendor_account_requirement.answer: Devin Desktop requires login with a Devin account.

first_task_setup.answer: Install the CLI for the host OS, restart the terminal, enter a project directory and run devin.

prerequisite_guidance.answer: Quickstart documents separate macOS/Linux/WSL and Windows installation paths.

instructions.answer: Knowledge stores reusable instructions and tips; new guidance should use Skills because Knowledge is deprecated.

project_docs.answer: Knowledge items can contain internal libraries and documentation.

memory.answer: Devin retrieves relevant saved Knowledge based on trigger descriptions.

scope.answer: Knowledge can be repo-pinned and scoped to organization or enterprise.

correction.answer: Users edit suggestions or request regenerated suggestions and updates.

deletion.answer: Users can disable an item without deleting it; the source does not establish every deletion lifecycle.

freshness.answer: The docs recommend maintaining short current items; automatic stale-context detection is not established.

roles.answer: The CLI main agent delegates independent workers using profiles.

model_harness_effort.answer: General workers inherit the parent model; custom profiles can pin a model. The live subagent panel does not identify the child model.

results_return.answer: The parent receives child completion and summarizes its result.

activation.answer: The agent selects foreground or background mode for each worker.

live_progress.answer: Subagent activity is available, but raw output is not directly shown to the human.

pending_decisions.answer: Foreground child tool calls can request human approval; background unapproved tool calls are denied.

hybrid.answer: Cloud work can request commands or edits on a connected local computer through Local Hands.

client_disconnect.answer: Closing the CLI terminal does not stop its cloud VM session.

other_device_continuation.answer: A cloud session started through CLI, web or Desktop can be resumed by URL or ID.

vm.answer: Devin Cloud runs on a virtual machine, unlike local CLI execution.

client_disconnect.answer: A cloud session keeps running when the local terminal closes.

transcript_reload.answer: CLI can select a recent cloud session or resume one started in web/Desktop.

task_resume.answer: devin --cloud --resume reopens an existing session by ID or URL.

failure_reasons.answer: The issue timeline and analysis identify problems and recommendations in completed sessions.

task_stats.answer: Insights summarizes completed sessions with usage, user-message count and size category.

time_stats.answer: Insights includes an issue timeline; precise runtime measurement methodology was not established.

session_cost.answer: Insights reports session ACU usage; this is a compute usage unit, not a complete reconciled monetary bill.

child_cost.answer: Each subagent incurs its own model usage in addition to the parent.

tokens.answer: Each child has an independent context and inference calls.

subscription_allowance.answer: Prompt-based plans charge additional credits for each child, according to its model.

compute_cost.answer: The Insights usage card displays Agent Compute Units consumed by the session.

tool.answer: Every Local Hands tool call requires user approval.

tunnels.answer: devin ssh connects to a cloud-session VM; devin forward supports port forwarding.

pending_reviews.answer: The Review inbox lists authored, assigned and awaiting-review PRs.

change_understanding.answer: Review groups related diffs and explains behavior.

comments.answer: Devin Review supports provider-dependent review comments.

request_changes.answer: GitHub reviews can request changes in the Devin interface.

narrow_screen.answer: Mobile review opens Changes, with Bugs and other tabs.

retained_context.answer: Review history can inspect an earlier analysis.

approve.answer: Devin Review can submit GitHub PR approvals with the required connection.

merge.answer: GitHub merge actions use the repository merge strategy and reflect required checks.

authority_enforcement.answer: GitHub write actions require an installed GitHub App connection; PAT connections are read-only.

review_queue.answer: Devin Review lists PRs awaiting review.

findings.answer: Bug and security findings have confidence or severity labels.

code_data.answer: The web application processes user-provided data; installed integrations have separately configured access.

prompts.answer: User-provided inputs are processed to deliver and maintain the service.

retention.answer: Customer data is retained for the customer relationship unless otherwise specified; feedback and interaction data have separate retention.

training.answer: By default data may train models; paid users can opt out, Teams admins control that opt-out, and Enterprise requires written consent.

provider_separation.answer: Paid training opt-out also enables zero data retention at model providers; this is not a telemetry-disable guarantee.

seats.answer: Teams support up to 200 users and charge $40 per full development seat monthly.

workspace_fees.answer: Teams have an $80 monthly base fee plus seat fees.

included_usage.answer: Paid usage allowances refresh daily and weekly, with model-dependent consumption.

overages.answer: Paid users can purchase extra usage at API pricing.

model_cost.answer: Model, task complexity and reasoning affect message cost.

deprecation.answer: Knowledge is deprecated, with gradual automatic migration to Skills in Plugins and removal in a future undated update.

soc2_type.answer: Cognition states SOC 2 Type II certification since September 2024.

report_access.answer: The security page links the Cognition Trust Center for additional details.

evidence_status.answer: Vendor attestation is public; the underlying audit report, period and exact scope were not inspected.

usage_caps.answer: Free has a light agent quota and limited model availability; paid allowances reset daily and weekly.

units.answer: Individual usage is a daily and weekly quota, with model-dependent message consumption.

overages.answer: Extra paid usage is consumed at API pricing.

sales_only_unknowns.answer: Enterprise dedicated deployment and pricing require sales contact.
